call_asset_inventory.shared_asset_risk: NONE. Because 407995613637 is exclusive to the five campaigns, no dedicated duplicate call asset is required and no campaign association has to be created or removed. A duplicate asset was validated as a fallback and is NOT part of this package.

approach.chosen: Update the ad_schedule_targets on the existing call asset 407995613637 in place, then remove all 30 campaign AD_SCHEDULE criteria.
approach.why: CallAsset.ad_schedule_targets lives on the Asset resource, so it is shared by every link the asset has. That is normally a reason to build a dedicated asset. Here the asset has exactly five links and all five are the campaigns in scope, so the in-place update is precisely scoped, needs one mutation instead of six, creates no duplicate phone asset, and preserves the asset's existing approval and history.
approach.why_no_all_day_rows: A campaign with zero AD_SCHEDULE criteria already delivers every hour of every day. This account proves it: these five campaigns carried no AD_SCHEDULE criterion from launch on 2026-08-14 until 2026-08-17 ~10:40 and served overnight and on Sunday during that window. Creating 35 all-day rows would be behaviourally identical, add 35 objects to audit, and re-introduce the pattern that caused this problem.
approach.operation_order: The asset schedule is applied FIRST and the campaign criteria are removed SECOND. Within one atomic request this ordering guarantees there is no instant in which the campaign is 24/7 while the call asset is still unrestricted.

operations.execution_shape: ONE GoogleAdsService.Mutate request containing 31 mutate_operations, partial_failure=false, so the whole package is atomic across both services.

before.meaning: no asset-level schedule; eligibility inherited entirely from the campaign schedule

after.sunday: ABSENT BY DESIGN. No SUNDAY row is created, so the call asset is ineligible all day Sunday.

partial_write_protocol: Send all 31 operations in ONE GoogleAdsService.Mutate request with partial_failure=false. If it fails, STOP, re-query the 30 criteria and the asset schedule to inventory what actually changed, and produce a recovery plan. Do not blindly rerun.
interaction_with_package_B: Package A raises eligible hours from 65 to 168 per week. That increases the impressions the same budget can buy, so it should be applied before or with Package B, and the August projection in Package B already assumes it.
